about: 회계 I › 고정자산증가 · 감소의 [수수료] · [거래처] · [처분손익계정](원본 E010611 · E010612, 2026-10-22 실측): QA회계1-수수료 1,000,000 + 수수료 2,000 + 거래처(첫 거래처) 등록 → 분개 차) 비품 1,000,000 · 부가세대급금 100,000 · 지급수수료 2,000 / 대) 외상매입금 1,102,000 → 처분(매각 500,000 · 수수료 3,000, 처분손익계정 비면 '처분이익 또는 처분손실 관련 계정을 입력 바랍니다.') → 분개 차) 외상매출금 547,000 · 지급수수료 3,000 / 대) 비품 500,000 · 부가세예수금 50,000 · 비품 500,000(취득원가상계) / 차) 처분손실 500,000. 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 증가 · 감소 수수료 · 거래처 · 처분손익계정
steps: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const a=(await (await fetch('/api/fixed-assets',{headers:h})).json()).filter(x=>x.name==='QA회계1-수수료');for(const x of a){if(x.status==='DISPOSED')await fetch('/api/fixed-assets/'+x.id+'/dispose',{method:'DELETE',headers:h});await fetch('/api/fixed-assets/'+x.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h})}return a.length})()

js:window.confirm=()=>true;window.__set=(el,v)=>{const p=el.tagName==='SELECT'?HTMLSelectElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype;Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(p,'value').set.call(el,v);el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}))};window.__q=n=>document.querySelector('[name='+n+']');window.__row=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find(r=>r.innerText.includes('QA회계1-수수료'));window.__api=async u=>(await fetch('/api'+u,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')}})).json();window.__lines=async()=>{const a=(await __api('/fixed-assets')).find(x=>x.name==='QA회계1-수수료');const out=[];for(const m of a.movements){const j=await __api('/journals/'+m.journalEntryId);out.push(m.kind+'#'+j.lines.map(l=>l.accountCode+(l.debit>0?'D'+l.debit:'C'+l.credit)+'['+(l.partnerName||'')+'|'+l.description+']').join(','))}return out};true
